title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
description:
arXiv:2611.06984v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation
